The following events took place in the '''10,970s BBY'''.

==Events==
*[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Pers Pradeux]] of the [[Renunciates]] discovers the location of [[Prefsbelt IV/Legends|Prefsbelt IV]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]] by citizens of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] who had fled the tyranny of the [[Pius Dea]] cult that controlled that government at the [[Time/Legends|time]]. Pradeux further established Prefsbelt as a retreat for Renunciate [[Navy/Legends|naval]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] who sought to overthrow the Pius Dea.<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
